The Triple Lotus Collection

After five years as an engineer and a series of successful racing cars, Colin Chapman formed Lotus Engineering Ltd in 1952. The first model out was the Lotus 6, which was built in 100 copies, also very successful in racing. One of the most famous models is probably the Lotus 7, which is still built today in various replica versions. Focus has always been on light weight and considerable amount of grip, and over the years Lotus has won countless races against opponents with considerably larger engines. Bidders Highway is honoured to auctioning three different Lotus cars. We chose to name this small but spectacular collection "The Triple Lotus Collection".

The Time Capsule Collection

When motorization took off in earnest, two-wheelers were the most common option people could afford. Many still dream today of being able to relive the motor vehicles of their youth. Bidders Highway has received a time capsule with no less than ten motorcycles in mint condition, ranging from the 50s to the 70s.

The Eclectic Coupé Collection

Bidders Highway has been given the opportunity to auction off a collection of eclectic coupés with the auction ending in the final days of February. The collection consists of four vehicles, all coupés, from the mid-50s to the late 80s. What about a spartan ice-cream cruiser from a collaboration between the States and Great Britain, or perhaps a luxurious cruiser that was the result of a collaboration between Sweden and Italy?
